successors.note: Fix fx-40 (2 Nov 2026), window request R145. Travancore-Cochin page (opened 2 Nov 2026): 'a short-lived state of India'; 'On 1 November 1956 Travancore-Cochin was joined with Malabar District of Madras State to form the new state of Kerala'; 'the four southern taluks of Travancore namely Thovalai, Agastheeswaram, Kalkulam and Vilavancode and a part of Sengottai in Tenkasi Taluk was merged with Madras State'; 'Devikulam - Peermade and Neyyattinkara Taluks were merged with the newly formed Kerala state'; infobox 'Merger to Kerala and Madras State: 1956'. Kerala and Madras State are states of India and have no dossier, so the successors that were named here ('kerala', 'madras-state') received nothing; the land passes to the republic-of-india dossier, which the p1950-p1959 patch already credits with it (events/3-4) and of which data/hierarchy.csv draws this state as a constituent in 1949-1956.

ledger.note: 1956: the southern Tamil taluks go to Madras State. 'Under the State Reorganisation Act of 1956' the taluks of Vilavancode, Kalkulam, Thovalai, Agastheeswaram and Sengottai 'were transferred from Travancore-Cochin to Madras State in 1956'. The page gives the year, and 1 November 1956 for the reorganisation; the month is the researcher's reading. The travancore dossier's Kanyakumari circle stands for the four taluks. Fix fx-40 (2 Nov 2026), R145: counterpart was madras-state, which has no dossier, so the cells went to nobody; Madras State is a state of India ('merged with Madras State', Travancore-Cochin page), so the receiving dossier is republic-of-india (the p1950-p1959 patch's events/4 is the same gain).

ledger.note: 1 November 1956: Travancore-Cochin joins Malabar to form Kerala. 'On 1 November 1956 Travancore-Cochin was joined with Malabar District of Madras State to form the new state of Kerala'; the infobox lists 'Merged into: Kerala and Madras State, 1956'. Fix fx-40 (2 Nov 2026), R145: counterpart was kerala, which has no dossier; Kerala is a state of India, so the remaining land passes to republic-of-india (identity.successors names it; the p1950-p1959 patch's events/3 is the same gain). Madras State took no more than the taluks of ledger/3; Kerala and Madras State are not drawn as states of their own.

certainty.note: The edges are the princely states' boundaries; the southern frontier with Madras State was fixed by the 1956 transfer of taluks. The dossier draws Kerala by the Travancore dossier's latitude box and Cochin by radii, so the outlines are approximate.

sources.title: Travancore-Cochin
sources.note: Formation 1 July 1949, capital Trivandrum, Rajpramukh, 1956 transfer of the southern taluks to Madras State, Kerala formed 1 November 1956; the page has no area.

notes: State Cliopatria lacks (no row). One page only, because the state is a seven-year administrative union whose land is the union of the travancore and kingdom-of-cochin dossiers' regions. The page is inconsistent on the southern transfer (five taluks in the lead, four and part of Sengottai in the body; half of Sengottai went to Tirunelveli district) and on the first election (1951 in the lead, 1952 in the body). President's rule is listed 23 March 1956 to 5 April 1957 in the succession table. Successors kerala and madras-state have no dossiers; the Malabar District and Kasaragod that joined Kerala in 1956 belong to the Madras Presidency / Madras State and are not drawn here. Sengottai's coordinates are approximate and the place is not in the gazetteer. The land is inside the Dominion and Republic of India (Cliopatria 'Republic of India' from 1947): the renderer should let this union take precedence over India's shape. No wars. [Fix fx-40, 2 Nov 2026, R145] identity.successors is republic-of-india (was kerala and madras-state, neither with a dossier); ledger/3 and ledger/4 name republic-of-india as counterpart. The hierarchy row (constituent of republic-of-india, 1949-1956) and the p1950-p1959 ruling keep the state drawn inside India until 1956.
